limitations: DATAFLOW validates complete legal LIMIT submultisets without exact encounter-order claims.
Discovery preserves existing absent-first-projection provenance behavior.
B schema uses separately completed independent materialized-node oracle; original partial producer status is unchanged.
This binds local actual response evidence and does not implement CI producer or accept construction/loading/pressure performance.

body.query: MATCH (n:CallSite) WITH collect(n.callee_name) AS names RETURN names[0..10] AS names
MATCH (n) UNWIND keys(n) AS k RETURN k, count(*) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 50
MATCH (n:CallSite) RETURN n.caller_class ORDER BY n.caller_class LIMIT 200
MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n) AS labels, count(*) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 40
MATCH (n:CallSite) WITH n.callee_class AS c WHERE c IS NOT NULL RETURN c LIMIT 200

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS '__graphite_fixture64_absent_fixture-android-00__'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS '__graphite_fixture64_absent_fixture-android-00__'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS '__graphite_fixture64_absent_fixture-android-00__'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS '__graphite_fixture64_absent_fixture-android-00__'
RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'android.media.internal.guava_common.util.concurrent.trustedlistenablefuturetask$trustedfutureinterruptibleasynctask'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'android.media.internal.guava_common.util.concurrent.trustedlistenablefuturetask$trustedfutureinterruptibleasynctask'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'android.media.internal.guava_common.util.concurrent.trustedlistenablefuturetask$trustedfutureinterruptibleasynctask'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'android.media.internal.guava_common.util.concurrent.trustedlistenablefuturetask$trustedfutureinterruptibleasynctask'
RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
RETURN n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200

MATCH (n)
WHERE n.caller_class CONTAINS 'get' OR n.caller_name CONTAINS 'get' OR n.callee_class CONTAINS 'get' OR n.callee_name CONTAINS 'get'
RETURN n.graphId, n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name
LIMIT 200
MATCH (n:CallSite) RETURN n.callee_class, count(*) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 20
MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) RETURN count(*)
MATCH (n:CallSite) RETURN n.callee_name ORDER BY n.callee_name DESC LIMIT 200
MATCH (n:CallSite) WITH n.callee_class AS c, count(*) AS k WHERE k > 5 RETURN c, k LIMIT 50
MATCH (a)-[*1..2]->(b) RETURN a.id, b.id LIMIT 200
MATCH (n) WHERE n.value CONTAINS 'android.permission.INTERNET' RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50
MATCH (n) WHERE n.qualifiedId CONTAINS '938826' RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.qualifiedId AS qualifiedId, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (n) WHERE any(k IN keys(n) WHERE toString(n[k]) CONTAINS 'android.permission.INTERNET') RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50
MATCH (n) WHERE toString(n.caller_class) CONTAINS 'android.app.Activity' RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (c)-[r:DATAFLOW]->(n) WHERE c.value CONTAINS 'android.permission.INTERNET' RETURN id(c) AS source, id(n) AS target, type(r) AS relationship, c.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (n) WHERE toString(n.caller_class) CONTAINS 'GraphiteSlowShapeAbsent293746X' RETURN id(n) AS id, labels(n) AS labels, n.value AS value, n.caller_class AS caller, n.graphId AS graphId LIMIT 50

MATCH (n)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'graphite_latency_no_such_symbol_9f36'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'graphite_latency_no_such_symbol_9f36'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'graphite_latency_no_such_symbol_9f36'
   OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'graphite_latency_no_such_symbol_9f36'

MATCH (n)

  AND (toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
    OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
    OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'get'
    OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_name, '')) CONTAINS 'get')
RETURN n.caller_class, n.caller_name, n.callee_class, n.callee_name

  AND (toLower(coalesce(n.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsentRoutingPairX'
    OR toLower(coalesce(n.caller_name, '')) CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsentRoutingPairX'
    OR toLower(coalesce(n.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'GraphitePressureAbsentRoutingPairX'

MATCH (n:FieldNode) RETURN n.graphId AS graphId, 'FieldNode' AS kind, n.generic_type IS NOT NULL AS rendered, n.type_info IS NOT NULL AS structured, count(*) AS members
UNION ALL
MATCH (n:ParameterNode) RETURN n.graphId AS graphId, 'ParameterNode' AS kind, n.generic_type IS NOT NULL AS rendered, n.type_info IS NOT NULL AS structured, count(*) AS members
UNION ALL
MATCH (n:ReturnNode) RETURN n.graphId AS graphId, 'ReturnNode' AS kind, n.generic_type IS NOT NULL AS rendered, n.type_info IS NOT NULL AS structured, count(*) AS members

MATCH (m:Method) RETURN m.graphId AS graphId, m.generic_return_type IS NOT NULL AS returnRendered, m.return_type_info IS NOT NULL AS returnStructured, m.generic_parameter_types IS NOT NULL AS parametersRendered, m.parameter_type_info IS NOT NULL AS parametersStructured, m.type_parameters IS NOT NULL AS formalParameters, count(*) AS members
